method: Independently reconstructed all queue identities before reading every stored full case; then reproduced exact counts and variants, verified KWICs, canonical work IDs, distinct-work spread, lexical boundaries, deployment, and dispositions.

identityReview.finding: Every canonicalIndex, queueNumber, id, term, and query exactly matches its authoritative queue row; all indexes satisfy canonicalIndex % 3 == 1 and are strictly ascending.

rows.term: 路逢達道人、不將語默對
rows.finding: Two distinct canonical works raise the whole maxim as a question and demand a mode of meeting beyond both speech and silence. The printed 、 form is absent, while the comma form reproduces at 86 hits in 48 works. Both clauses are indispensable, so KEEP (couplet) stands.

Independent case critics explicitly use the expression to appraise responsive handling fitted to the occasion, then qualify its adequacy. This is a recurrent Chan-critical verdict rather than literal seating; KEEP (component) stands.

Both witnesses are direct master-level criticisms of overreaching or overconfident Dharma presentation, not crowd description. The graph form is controlled: 傍若無人 reproduces at 75 hits/53 works, while related 旁若無人 is separately attested at 45/23 and is not substituted into either witness. KEEP (component) stands.

rows.term: 竿頭絲線從君弄、不犯清波意自殊
rows.finding: The full fishing pair caps a release/hold challenge and independently the Luzhu–Nanquan case appraisal. Manipulating the line and leaving clear water undisturbed form one contrastive image. The printed 、 form is absent and the comma form reproduces at 74/53; KEEP (couplet) stands.

Two independent case collections make the phrase an explicit critic's verdict on a master's overbearing technique and immediately diagnose the encounter flaw. That recurring adjudicative deployment supports KEEP (component), rather than mere incidental description.

The noon-sun line is a direct answer to the present-day sentence and independently a lay practitioner's formal cap that the master tests before the assembly. It is deliberately deployed rather than temporal narration; KEEP (component) stands.

The legal maxim directly answers an accusation of blind punishment and independently caps a monk's request for expedient treatment after being struck. The repeated fault/punishment verdict supports KEEP (component).
Both addresses coordinate the impossible rescue image with 頭上安頭 to reject negative and affirmative reification. It functions as a stable diagnostic contrast; KEEP (component) stands.

A case critic uses the phrase to cap Devadatta's own stated position, while another master uses it to certify the layman's immediately preceding response. This repeated self-authentication verdict supports KEEP (component).

Independent formal addresses deliberately wield the paradoxical animal/number image as a cap, once among impossible transformations and once with an iron snake across the ancient road followed by a command to investigate. It is not animal narrative; KEEP (component) stands.
